title: test_dao_prefix_authorization: 8 token fixtures still use Identity.iid delegate (latent two-convention)
description: Codereview pass 3 on v1kc fix: python/tests/rpl/test_dao_prefix_authorization.py:308,327,335,347,360,367,379,385,391 still pass NODE_IDENTITY.iid as the token delegate while the file now defines NODE_DELEGATE (= NODE_ADDR.packed[8:16]) as the delegate-key convention. Verified outcome-neutral today (all are install-only paths where delegate is opaque payload, or wire-profile rejects before authorization), but: (a) line 308's docstring claims 'a seeded /64 delegation' for this origin while the seeded token is bound to an IID the origin never presents — if check ordering ever changed it would fail with misleading delegate_mismatch; (b) the file models two contradictory delegate-key conventions for future copy-paste. Swap the remaining sites to NODE_DELEGATE for uniformity.
